prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high fidelity desktop web app screenshot for Ritmo, in Spanish, landscape 1536x1024, flat edge to edge screenshot without browser/device frame. This is a functional study progress and planning app for students, not a landing page. Original art direction: the academic weekly timetable elevated into a calm sophisticated product. Off-white #f7f8fa workspace, dark petrol #203b52 type and compact left navigation, terracotta #da6244 primary action, restrained sage and pale blue subject fills. No purple, gradients, glowing orbs, decorative imagery or eyebrow text. Consistent small outlined icons, elegant humanist sans typography. Left rail width 190 with ritmo wordmark, Mi semana selected, Mis sesiones, Materias, Ajustes, and Iniciar sesión at bottom. Main top heading 'Tu semana, a tu ritmo.' and supporting text 'Organiza el estudio. Haz espacio para avanzar.' Right top button 'Planificar sesión'. Under heading a compact inline progress strip, not giant metric cards: '3 h 20 min estudiados', '5 sesiones', 'Meta semanal 300 min'. Dominant central weekly schedule grid spanning 7 weekday columns Lun 26 through Dom 1, generous height and beautiful fine rules with colored study session blocks: Matemáticas 45 min, Historia 25 min, Biología 40 min, Inglés 30 min. Current day emphasized with a dark petrol small date square. Schedule is a real planning tool, with lightly labeled times 09:00, 11:00, 15:00. Narrow right area 'Tu siguiente paso' with next study session and compact 25:00 timer and 'Empezar enfoque' button, not a progress ring. Bottom section 'Sesiones recientes' as crisp table with Tema, Materia, Duración, Fecha, two rows and secondary 'Ver todas'. Include unobtrusive 'Vista previa · datos de ejemplo' near the top. Spacious but information-rich, exceptional grid discipline, very readable accessible text. The weekly schedule is the single dominant focal area. No invented notifications, streaks, testimonials, revenue, profile identity.
